sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A perennial vine cultivated in warm regions and native to tropical America. Its creeping or climbing stems bear highly variable leaves, often 4–14 × 4–16 cm.

sections.title: Roots and flowers
sections.text: The edible storage organs are tuberous roots, not stem tubers. The funnel-shaped flowers are usually lilac.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: The roots are eaten cooked; young leaves are also eaten as a vegetable in some regions.
